test_xla_compile: test XLA compilation of Sonnet modules using tf.xla.experimental.compile with golden reference outputs
test_xla_jit_scope: test XLA JIT scoping of Sonnet modules using tf.xla.experimental.jit_scope with golden reference outputs
create_golden_module: create a Sonnet module instance from a golden test case for XLA conformance testing
create_golden_variables: create all variables for a Sonnet module in a golden test case
run_golden_forward: run forward pass of a Sonnet module with golden test inputs and compare outputs
